ccd.gauge.target_amount.tooltip: Enter 0–100000 mB. 1000 mB is one bucket; 0 monitors only.

ccd.configuration.boosterPump.stressMult: Stress cost relative to a Mechanical Pump at the same speed. Reopen the world to apply changes.
ccd.configuration.boosterPump.pressureMu: Pumping pressure relative to a Mechanical Pump at the same speed; affects flow rate. Reopen the world to apply changes.
ccd.configuration.boosterPump.rangeMulti: Multiplier of the configured Mechanical Pump range, applied to each side. Reopen the world to apply changes.
ccd.configuration.fluidArm.allowDirectCo: When disabled, arms require Fluid Hatches. When enabled, they can target accessible container faces directly. Reopen the world to apply changes.
ccd.configuration.smartTank.maxFluidType: Maximum fluid types per vertical or horizontal tank structure. Different components count separately; lowering the limit preserves existing contents. Reopen the world to apply changes.
ccd.configuration.waterSupply.rate.toolt: Measured in mB/tick per container, supplied in batches. -1 fills available space per operation; 0 disables automatic supply. Manual extraction is unaffected. Reopen the world to apply changes.
ccd.configuration.atomizer.normalConsump: Measured in mB/second of active spray. Custom atomizing recipes may override this value. Reopen the world to apply changes.
ccd.configuration.atomizer.potionConsump: Measured in mB/second of potion spray. Custom recipes may override this value. Reopen the world to apply changes.
block.ccd.booster_pump.tooltip.summary: Provides greater _pumping pressure_ and _range_ at a higher stress cost.
block.ccd.booster_pump.tooltip.behaviour: Connect pipes at either end and shafts to the four sides. _Rotation direction_ determines flow.
block.ccd.fluid_transmitter.tooltip.summ: _Transfers fluid_ between containers on opposite sides without rotational power.
block.ccd.fluid_transmitter.tooltip.beha: Transfers towards the housing _arrows_. Straight chains share one transfer allowance.
_Pauses_ transfer. Side filters select which fluids may pass.
block.ccd.redstone_fluid_valve.tooltip.s: Opens or closes a fluid pipe using _redstone_, without rotational power.
block.ccd.redstone_fluid_valve.tooltip.b: _Opens_ the passage; closes without a signal. A pump is still required to move fluid.
block.ccd.three_way_valve.tooltip.summar: _Switches_ between two branches to select a fluid source or destination.
block.ccd.three_way_valve.tooltip.behavi: Connects the silver _common port_ to the opposite _straight port_.
Connects the common port to the _side port_. Green marks the selected branch; pumps determine flow direction.
block.ccd.three_way_valve.tooltip.action: Adjusts the branch orientation or rotates the valve.
block.ccd.faucet.tooltip.summary: _Pours fluid_ downwards from a container without rotational power. Stores no fluid.
block.ccd.faucet.tooltip.condition1: With a Container or Cauldron Directly Below
block.ccd.faucet.tooltip.behaviour1: Draws from the _container behind_ and pours downwards. Stops when the target cannot accept fluid.
block.ccd.faucet.tooltip.behaviour2: _Pauses_ flow without changing the manual setting.
block.ccd.smart_faucet.tooltip.summary: _Pours fluid_ downwards from a container without rotational power. Filters fluids and fills items.
block.ccd.smart_faucet.tooltip.condition: With a Container or Cauldron Directly Below
block.ccd.smart_faucet.tooltip.behaviour: Draws from the _container behind_ and pours downwards. Stops when the target cannot accept fluid.
block.ccd.smart_faucet.tooltip.condition: With a Belt or Depot Two Blocks Below
block.ccd.smart_faucet.tooltip.behaviour: Leave the intervening block clear. Processes items using _Spout filling recipes_.
_Pauses_ flow without changing the manual setting.
block.ccd.smart_faucet.tooltip.action2: Allows only _matching fluid_ for pouring and filling.
block.ccd.fluid_packager.tooltip.summary: Packs fluid into _Copper Packages_ and unloads arriving packages into a container.
block.ccd.fluid_packager.tooltip.behavio: Packs up to _4000 mB_ at a time. Redstone packs available fluid; logistics splits the _requested amount_ into packages.
Waits until the container can accept the entire fluid payload.
block.ccd.fluid_packager.tooltip.action1: Samples a _fluid filter_ without consuming the sample. Applies to redstone packaging.
block.ccd.fluid_packager.tooltip.control: Sneak + R-Click with an Empty Hand
item.ccd.fluid_stock.tooltip.summary: A marker for selecting _fluids_ in logistics. Each count represents _1 mB_.
item.ccd.fluid_stock.tooltip.behaviour1: Represents a request; actual fluid travels in _Copper Packages_.
block.ccd.fluid_gauge.tooltip.summary: Monitors _fluid stock_ in a logistics network and requests replenishment to a target amount.
block.ccd.fluid_gauge.tooltip.condition1: When Attached to a Receiving Packager
block.ccd.fluid_gauge.tooltip.behaviour1: Maintains _target stock_ in the container behind. Outstanding deliveries count towards the target.
block.ccd.fluid_gauge.tooltip.control1: R-Click a Stock Link before Placing
block.ccd.fluid_gauge.tooltip.control2: R-Click Briefly with a Fluid Sample
block.ccd.fluid_gauge.tooltip.action2: Selects the _fluid_ to monitor or request.
block.ccd.fluid_gauge.tooltip.action3: Adjusts the target; the input accepts _exact mB_. Set 0 to monitor only.
block.ccd.fluid_arm.tooltip.summary: Uses rotation to _move fluid_ between selected containers, up to _1000 mB_ per trip.
block.ccd.fluid_arm.tooltip.behaviour1: Select the _front of Fluid Hatches_ by default.
block.ccd.fluid_arm.tooltip.behaviour2: _Pauses pickup_. Carried fluid is still delivered and retained if outputs are blocked.
block.ccd.fluid_arm.tooltip.action1: Cycles between _input_, _output_ and deselected. Sneak-right-click removes a target.
block.ccd.fluid_arm.tooltip.control2: R-Click an Existing Arm with the Arm Item
block.ccd.fluid_arm.tooltip.action2: Applies selected targets; sneak-right-click clears them.
block.ccd.fluid_hatch.tooltip.summary: Provides _handheld_ and _Pipetting Arm_ access to the container behind. Does not relay pipe connections.
block.ccd.fluid_hatch.tooltip.behaviour1: Interact with the exposed _front_. The attached container face retains its restrictions.
block.ccd.fluid_hatch.tooltip.control1: R-Click with a Bucket, Bottle or Fluid Container
block.ccd.fluid_hatch.tooltip.action1: Attempts to _empty_ first, then _fill_ if emptying is not possible.
block.ccd.smart_fluid_hatch.tooltip.summ: Provides _handheld_ and _Pipetting Arm_ access to the container behind. Filters incoming and outgoing fluid.
block.ccd.smart_fluid_hatch.tooltip.beha: Interact with the exposed _front_. The attached container face retains its restrictions.
_Blocks transfer_. Set a filter to allow matching fluids.
block.ccd.smart_fluid_hatch.tooltip.cont: R-Click with a Bucket, Bottle or Fluid Container
block.ccd.smart_fluid_hatch.tooltip.acti: Attempts to _empty_ first, then _fill_ if emptying is not possible.
block.ccd.smart_fluid_tank.tooltip.summa: Stores _multiple fluids separately_ within shared capacity. Connects vertically.
block.ccd.smart_fluid_tank.tooltip.behav: A _1×1, 2×2 or 3×3_ square cross-section combines capacity along its length.
Without a filter, extracts the _first listed fluid_. Use filtering to select another.
block.ccd.horizontal_smart_fluid_tank.to: Stores _multiple fluids separately_ within shared capacity. Connects horizontally.
A _1×1, 2×2 or 3×3_ square cross-section combines capacity along its length.
Without a filter, extracts the _first listed fluid_. Use filtering to select another.
block.ccd.copper_water_basin.tooltip.sum: Provides _infinite water_. Fill containers by hand or extract through pipes.
block.ccd.copper_water_basin.tooltip.beh: Incoming fluid is _discarded_; the water supply remains unchanged.
block.ccd.copper_water_basin.tooltip.act: _Fills_ containers that accept water without replacing another fluid.
block.ccd.copper_water_basin.tooltip.con: Sneak + R-Click with a Filled Container
block.ccd.copper_water_supply.tooltip.su: Provides _infinite water_. Automatically fills containers on all six adjacent faces.
block.ccd.copper_water_supply.tooltip.be: Incoming fluid is _discarded_; the water supply remains unchanged.
_Pauses automatic supply_ only; manual and piped extraction remain available.
block.ccd.copper_water_supply.tooltip.ac: _Fills_ containers that accept water without replacing another fluid.
block.ccd.copper_water_supply.tooltip.co: Sneak + R-Click with a Filled Container
block.ccd.copper_collection_grate.toolti: Collects connected fluid above, rain and powder snow, then drains _downwards_.
Gradually drains the _connected pool_, stopping when full. Also catches dripstone fluids.
block.ccd.smart_collection_grate.tooltip: Collects connected fluid above, rain and powder snow, then drains _downwards_. Adds filtering and redstone control.
Gradually drains the _connected pool_, stopping when full. Also catches dripstone fluids.
Pauses automatic collection and downward output; pipes and handheld access remain available.
Accepts matching fluid; existing contents remain drainable. Empty filters accept all fluids.
item.ccd.copper_bucket.tooltip.summary: A general-purpose bucket holding _4000 mB_ of _one fluid_.
item.ccd.copper_bucket.tooltip.behaviour: Picks up or places _1000 mB_ at a time. Collects source fluid only; creative placement preserves contents.
item.ccd.copper_bucket.tooltip.action1: _Fills_ from the clicked face, up to capacity.
item.ccd.copper_bucket.tooltip.action2: _Empties_ into a container or forces world placement.
item.ccd.honeycomb_mold.tooltip.summary: A reusable mold for pressing honey into _honeycomb_.
item.ccd.honeycomb_mold.tooltip.behaviou: A Mechanical Press uses _250 mB_ of honey per operation and _returns the mold_.
item.minecraft.powder_snow_bucket.toolti: Powder snow can be _stored, pumped and packaged as fluid_, with _1000 mB_ per bucket.
Acts as a _freezing medium_ when a compatible processing addon is installed.
item.ccd.quicksand_bucket.tooltip.summar: A _sanding medium_ made by mixing sand. Can be bucketed, pumped and transported.
item.ccd.quicksand_bucket.tooltip.behavi: Processes _Sandpaper Polishing recipes_ in bulk without sandpaper.
item.ccd.quicksand_bucket.tooltip.action: Uses _1000 mB_ to form a sanding catalyst when that feature is enabled.
item.ccd.fluid_package.tooltip.condition: When inserted into a Fluid Packager
item.ccd.fluid_package.tooltip.behaviour: _Empties_ its fluid into the attached container.
item.ccd.fluid_package.tooltip.action1: R-Click in the inventory to _copy the address_; L-Click to _paste_.
item.ccd.composite_package.tooltip.summa: A package for transporting _items_ and _fluids_ together.
item.ccd.composite_package.tooltip.behav: _Combines_ items and fluids from the same order.
item.ccd.composite_package.tooltip.actio: _Returns the items_ and separates fluids into _Copper Packages_.
block.ccd.fluid_access_port.tooltip.summ: Extends the _fluid access faces_ of an attached container.
block.ccd.fluid_access_port.tooltip.beha: The other five faces accept _Fluid Pipes_ or other devices. Cannot extend another Access Port.
block.ccd.fluid_bridge.tooltip.summary: Accesses fluid in _two containers_ through a single connection.
block.ccd.fluid_bridge.tooltip.behaviour: Only _matching fluid_ can enter or leave that end.
block.ccd.fluid_bridge.tooltip.control1: When R-Clicked on an end face
block.ccd.fluid_atomizer.tooltip.behavio: Consumes stored _fluid_ to apply its _processing effect_ to the air current.
Applies _potion effects_ to entities in the air current.
_Stops atomizing_ without stopping the air current.
block.ccd.fluid_atomizer.tooltip.control: When R-Clicked with a Fluid Container
block.ccd.fluid_atomizer.tooltip.action1: _Inserts_ or _extracts_ fluid. Pipes connect to the four sides.
item.ccd.seething_reagent_bucket.tooltip: When inserted into a Fluid Atomizer
Applies _seething_ processing to the air current.
item.ccd.enriching_reagent_bucket.toolti: When inserted into a Fluid Atomizer
Applies _enriching_ processing to the air current.
item.ccd.soul_stripping_reagent_bucket.t: When inserted into a Fluid Atomizer
Applies _soul stripping_ processing to the air current.
item.ccd.explosive_slurry_bucket.tooltip: When inserted into a Fluid Atomizer
Applies _exploding_ processing to the air current.
item.ccd.resonant_solution_bucket.toolti: When inserted into a Fluid Atomizer
Applies _resonance_ processing to the air current.
item.ccd.sculk_suspension_bucket.tooltip: When inserted into a Fluid Atomizer
Applies _sculking_ processing to the air current.
item.ccd.purifying_solution_bucket.toolt: When inserted into a Fluid Atomizer
Applies _purifying_ processing to the air current.
